title: Rippers Unmasked — Guise
description: The Guise (mask / identity swap) as a first-class Project FU classFeature, on the Arcanist Arcanum pattern: hold several guises, bind one to make it active (dismissing any other), and its embedded ActiveEffect deltas apply on swap. Registers 'guise' on FU's module-open classFeature registry — no system fork. Original campaign content. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

recommends.reason: The Bonds tab renders Deeper Bonds natively via its API when present; without it the tab shows a plain read-only bond list.

rippers-guise.note: v0.7.19 (Tier-2 P5c — CLOSES P5): the character's Quirks are now settable from the guise editor. god ruled (from canon, no Austin needed) that quirks are PER-CHARACTER, not per-guise (creation Step 8 Keystone/Quirk; already character-owned 'effect' Items on the Quirk tab since v0.7.11; C4 = quirks stack) — so NO per-guise quirk model was invented. Instead the GuiseBuilderApp's Review step gained a 'Character Quirks' fieldset that lists the character's quirks and adds / opens / removes them, reusing the sheet's existing sheetAddQuirk/sheetEditQuirk/sheetRemoveQuirk on this.actor (wired in the builder's _onRender). Specialties were already handled correctly (Innate-only, free-authored) and are unchanged; none added to worn guises. Also VERIFIED this release (Coroner's compendium gap-call): the inline-bond emotion selects are exactly the canonical six pairs — Admiration/Inferiority, Loyalty/Mistrust, Affection/Hatred — pulled from the FU BondDataModel; zero occurrences of the fabricated Infatuation/Envy anywhere in the module, so no correction was needed. P5 is now closed (P5a theme+density v0.7.18, P5b = the v0.7.15 Effects tab, P5c quirks here). Tests 171/171. Module then STANDS BY: Tier-3 (Study roll, Rituals/Projects) and Level-Up are held pending Austin's rulings. --- v0.7.18 (Tier-2 P5 — guise-editor pass, part 1): (IN-CONTEXT OPEN, owed item) every guise card on the Form tab now has an Edit button that opens the themed GuiseBuilderApp in-context (data-action=openEditor → sheetOpenEditor → openGuiseBuilder; dismiss-before-edit per G3), instead of only the Edit-tab mini-panel — no stray raw item window. (P5a THEME + DENSITY) the guise editor is re-skinned from the old template purple (#7b2d8e) to the 2a-Slash BLOOD register — red #c8102a / bone / gold on a dark ground, Pirata One legends+buttons, mono numerals — matching the shipped actor-sheet register (declared on .application.guise-builder since the builder renders in an ApplicationV2 window OUTSIDE .rippers-sheet, so --rs-* tokens don't reach it), and tightened (denser fieldset padding / gaps) to kill the negative space. Colour/font/density only; the wizard's flex/grid layout is unchanged. (P5b SKILL/PASSIVE VISIBILITY) already served: the builder's Skills step lists each class's skills with SL + max, and LIVE passive-verification ('is this passive applying?') is the new Effects tab from v0.7.15 (a guise passive shows there as an active Passive with its source) — a per-skill 'passive' MARKER inside the builder is NOT added because our parseClassSkills has no is-passive datum (⚠ owed, would need a data source). (P5c QUIRK + SPECIALTIES) Specialties ALREADY exist in the editor (Innate-mode, free-authored text + count cap); NOT added to worn guises (canon: Specialties are Innate-Guise-only). QUIRK field is HELD pending an Austin ruling flagged to god: quirks are currently CHARACTER-owned 'effect' Items (the Quirk tab), but P5c says 'the guise's Quirk' — per-guise vs per-character ownership is a design decision, not invented here. Tests 171/171 (no logic change). LEVEL-UP still held pending Austin's ruling. --- v0.7.17 (Tier-2 P4 — DEFAULT TO THE BASIC GUISE, not Unmasked): Austin — 'Unmasked form doesn't make sense. It should default to his basic Guise.' When the sheet opens with NO active guise, it now wears the character's basic guise (the Innate guise if present — their normal-shape starter self — else the first guise) so the sheet shows real skills/stats instead of the bare Unmasked shell. Implemented in the sheet's _onRender via _ensureDefaultGuise(): owner-only, guarded against re-entry + the in-flight lock, and it wears the guise with NO swap cost (new bindGuiseNoCost = _bindCore without the H3 accountGuiseSwap — the default-on-open is not a turn action, per H3). A character who owns NO guise stays Unmasked (that state still exists conceptually). Swapping to other guises is unaffected. NOTE/behaviour to eyeball: because the trigger is 'no active guise on open', a character deliberately dismissed to Unmasked will re-default to the basic guise the next time the sheet is opened — matches the literal spec; flag if a persistent Unmasked is wanted instead. Pure helper defaultActiveGuiseId added + tested; tests 170->171. NEXT: v0.7.18 P5 (guise editor 2a theme/density + in-context open + skill/passive visibility + Quirk/Specialties fields); LEVEL-UP still held pending Austin's ruling. --- v0.7.16 (Tier-1 blocker #1 — SPELLS): the Spells tab is no longer a stub. It lists the actor's native 'spell' Items with MP cost / target / duration (fields verified against the FU spell data model: system.mpCost.value / target.value / duration.value / isOffensive.value), a Cast button that invokes native item.roll() (same pipeline base FU uses), an Add-spell button (creates a blank type:'spell' Item and opens its sheet), open-sheet and delete. Spells are ACTOR-OWNED and persist across guise swaps (like the Hunter Weapon), NOT materialised from a guise's classes — our data model has no class→spell mapping, so auto-materialisation on guise-bind is DEFERRED (⚠ owed; flagged to god as a design question — whether a spellcasting guise should stamp its class spells onto the actor needs an Austin ruling + a class→spell dataset). Nothing invented: pure native item surfacing + native cast. buildSpellsVM added + tested; tests 169->170. NEXT: v0.7.17 Level Up. --- v0.7.15 (Tier-1 parity, 'native surfacing' chunk — all data is native FU/Foundry, zero invented field names; schema verified against the FU dev checkout): (1) ACTIVE EFFECTS panel restored — new Effects tab lists the actor's Active Effects via actor.allApplicableEffects() (so effects TRANSFERRED from owned items/guises show too), bucketed Temporary/Passive/Inactive by isTemporary/active, with native create (per-bucket, data-effect-type), toggle (effect.update disabled), edit (effect.sheet.render), delete (effect.delete). This is the passive-verification surface (a guise passive shows here as an active Passive with its source name) — closes parity blocker #3 + P5(b). (2) FULL INVENTORY — the Kit tab now shows armor/shields/accessories/consumables/treasures (was weapons-only), read from actor.itemTypes.<type> with each type's real system.* fields (armor/shield/accessory: def.value/mdef.value/init.value; consumable: ipCost.value + subtype.value; treasure: cost.value/quantity.value/subtype.value), each with open-sheet + delete, consumables with a Use button (item.roll()). Closes blocker #2 + resolves the audit's 'item delete UNCLEAR' (explicit delete control added). (3) EQUIP/UNEQUIP loose gear — a per-item Equip/Unequip toggle writes the actor's native system.equipped record (armor/accessory single slot, shield→offHand, weapon→mainHand and both hands if two-handed, toggling an equipped item clears it; equipped rows are gold-accented), plus a 'Use equipment' master checkbox (system.useEquipment.value). Adapts PFU equipment-handler LOGIC (MIT); no rules values invented. Closes blocker #5. Pure helpers equipToggleUpdate/effectBucket/itemEquippable/itemIsTwoHanded/buildInventoryVM/buildEffectsVM added + tested; tests 164->169. NEXT: v0.7.16 Spells (list + cast). --- v0.7.14 (Forge eyeball of v0.7.13): THREE nits. (P1) ARCANA PICKER OVERLAP FIXED — the card images stacked on each other. The picker renders in a DialogV2 (OUTSIDE .rippers-sheet) so BOTH core Foundry and the Project FU system stylesheet reach the tiles and were collapsing the grid / mis-positioning them; the fix forces the load-bearing layout with !important scoped to .rg-arcana-picker (display:grid, auto-fill minmax(96px) columns, gap) and resets the tile+img box model (position:static, float:none, width/height/margin) so no external rule can win; each tile now also shows a name caption under the image; grid scrolls (max-height 60vh). Swap flow UNTOUCHED (still decoupled from FilePicker.browse). (P2) BONDS EDITABLE INLINE on the Edit tab — name + the three FU emotion pairs as SELECTS (blank + the exact BondDataModel choices Admiration/Inferiority, Loyalty/Mistrust, Affection/Hatred), a read-only derived Strength (= count of set emotions; the old writable strength input was a no-op — strength is a getter, not a stored field), a read-only tier chip, and add/remove rows. A bond is FLEETING BY DEFAULT (the fleeting/solid/eternal tier is owned by rippers-deeper-bonds, matched by name; a bond with no record reads fleeting) — so 'make a fleeting bond inline' = add a bond inline; NO fleeting field was invented on the FU array, and promotion to solid/eternal stays GM-gated on the Bonds tab per Deeper Bonds' rules (there is no player revert-to-fleeting in the rules). Inline add/remove operate on the character's own system.bonds (owner-permitted), NOT the GM-gated Deeper createFleetingBond. (P3) GUISE LOAD PERF — the sheet was doing ~2×(guises×classes) AWAITED compendium fromUuid pulls on every render (each class re-fetched per guise, and twice: skillsForClass + a name lookup). Now every unique class/heroic UUID is resolved ONCE, in parallel, into maps before the guise loop, which then reads them synchronously — the bottleneck was that serial compendium I/O, not the arcana art (guiseArcana is sync). Tests 164/164. STILL OWED (bigger UI, Austin to eyeball): guise EDITOR (GuiseBuilderApp) 2a-Slash theme, open guise-edit fully in-context from the card, broad contrast/font/overflow audit. --- v0.7.8 (ROS-30): fixed the DUPLICATED Guise section header on the Features tab. ROOT CAUSE: buildBenefitPanel's header carried the class `items-main-header rippers-guise-header` — so a `.rippers-guise-header` selector matched BOTH the benefit panel's header and the guise panel's header, reading as a duplicated Guise header (god's DOM: copy 1 parent .rippers-benefit-panel, copy 2 parent .rippers-guise-panel). It was never a second panel (the .rippers-guise-panel container was always single). FIX: the Benefit header now uses its own class `rippers-benefit-header`, and the three CSS rules that styled `.rippers-benefit-panel .rippers-guise-header` were repointed to `.rippers-benefit-header` (identical styling preserved). Now exactly ONE <header> carries rippers-guise-header, inside .rippers-guise-panel only. Regression tests assert exactly one rippers-guise-header header + the benefit panel uses its own class + no CSS re-couples them. Tests 58/58. (v0.7.8 is the same work order as v0.7.7 ROS-29; v0.7.7 shipped a beat before this dropped, so this is a follow-on build — install v0.7.8 to verify BOTH the persistence work and this header fix at once.) --- v0.7.7 (ROS-29): Specialties + Hunter Weapon PERSIST across guise swaps. Investigation found both are already swap-invariant at the DATA level — Specialties live on the Innate-guise ITEM (system.data.specialties), the Hunter Weapon is a plain CHARACTER-owned weapon carrying an isHunterWeapon flag, and neither is ever added to a guise's `owned` set (which is all _dismissCore deletes) nor keyed off the active-guise flag. bind/dismiss/setActiveGuise only flip the active flag and materialise/remove the MASK's own skills+equipment. This release HARDENS + PROVES that: (1) new actorHunterWeapon(actor) read helper, symmetric with actorSpecialties — both find their target by scanning items, independent of which guise is active; (2) a belt-and-suspenders guard in _dismissCore that refuses to delete a Hunter Weapon or any Guise item even if one were mis-tracked in `owned`; (3) regression tests proving actorSpecialties + actorHunterWeapon are unchanged through a swap A→B→none. Tests 56/56. ⚠ SURFACED to god (owed): the ONE swap-time effect on the HW is that a worn mask's own weapons occupy the character's HANDS while worn (the mask carries armour+two hands+accessory), DISPLACING the HW from its equipped slot until dismiss (preBindEquip restores it). Whether the HW should instead stay in hand OVER a mask's weapon is a canon/design fork (HW 'carries the Innate Guise instead of armour and hands') — not changed here pending Austin's ruling. --- v0.7.6 (ROS-24, god's live root-cause): the guardrails were COMPUTED but never CONSUMED by the wizard chrome — you could advance through every step and Create with any invalid config. Four fixes: (1) WIRED validation into the wizard: the Next button is now disabled on a step whose own guardrails fail (per-step scoping via guiseStepErrors, so step 1 with <3 classes is not trapped) and the step's errors render inline above the footer; Create/Create&Bind stay gated on whole-draft canCreate. (2) GATED _doCreate: it recomputes the FULL guardrail set (now incl. min-per-class + budget) and refuses with a warning even if a disabled button were triggered. (3) Added the MISSING rules to validateGuiseDraft: every class must carry >=1 SL ('Each class needs at least one skill.' — no piling the whole budget into one class) and the TOTAL allocation must fit the SL budget (guiseDraftToData silently clamped before, so an over-budget draft looked valid then dropped SL on Create). (4) SPECIALTY die-bump PICKER: arming from the sheet now prompts for WHICH attribute's die to improve (DEX/INS/MIG/WLP) and passes it through armSpecialtyDieBump({attribute}); the existing magic/accuracy exclusion and chooseBumpSlot fallback (preferred attribute if in the check, else primary) are unchanged. Regression tests added (min-per-class block, over-budget block, per-step scoping, picker options); tests 54/54. --- v0.7.5 (COMPENDIUM-MAXSL-FALLBACK-FIX, ROS-27, folded into the still-unshipped v0.7.4 so Austin installs ONE build): parseClassSkills mis-defaulted no-badge skills to Max SL 10. The compendium generator (build-compendium.mjs) omits the 【Max SL N】 badge ONLY for max_sl=1 (single-rank) BY DOCUMENTED CONVENTION, so 'no badge' means cap 1, not 10 — Coroner's ROS-27 audit confirmed all 89 no-badge skills are true max_sl=1 and every multi-rank skill carries an explicit badge, so nothing relied on the old default. Consumer-side fix only (god's option b): the fallback is now 1, which combines with the v0.7.4 three-layer skill clamp so a single-rank skill can no longer be over-allocated. No compendium/build-compendium change. Regression tests added (no-badge parses to maxSl:1; a no-badge skill clamps a SKILLS-step entry to 1). Tests 50/50. --- v0.7.4 (ROS-24, Austin's v0.7.3 review): (1) PERK is now FREE TEXT — the curated 21-perk grid is gone; the player writes the perk in prose (like Tell/Bane/flaw/Nature). (2) D-BONUS is a NARRATIVE scope, not a mechanical check type — the Open/Opposed/Group selector is removed; the player writes the circumstance the +3 applies to (e.g. 'when acting to protect a child') and the GM applies it. No mechanical-type gating, no ActiveEffect; shown in Review as '+3 to [descriptor] (GM-applied)'. This supersedes the v0.7.2 D-Bonus framing (the Specialty die-bump's magic/accuracy exclusion is unchanged). (3) SKILL-LEVEL CAP BUG FIXED — the per-skill max SL was enforced at compile/create but the SKILLS-step number input let you TYPE past it (the HTML max attribute does not block manual entry) and displayed the over-max value, so it read as 'no limit'. The input now CLAMPS to the skill's max SL on entry, the display clamps too, and validateGuiseDraft additionally BLOCKS Create if any skill exceeds its max. Regression tests added. Tests 48/48. --- v0.7.3 (ROS-24): added a one-click Specialty ARM/DISARM button on the character sheet's guises panel (shown only when the character has Specialties on their Innate Guise) — arms the die-bump for the next Open/skill Check without a macro; turns green while armed. Ritual checks stay ELIGIBLE (Austin: only magic/accuracy/display excluded). --- v0.7.2 (ROS-24): D-Bonus RULED — Austin ruled the +3 Bonus follows the same rule as Specialties, so it must NOT apply to Accuracy or Magic checks. The selector is now Open / Opposed / Group ONLY (Accuracy + Magic dropped); all GM-situational, so there is NO ActiveEffect — the +3 is stored/labelled data the GM applies at the table. --- v0.7.1 (ROS-24 follow-up): (1) HUNTER WEAPON authoring in Innate mode — a fieldset to drag a weapon Item as the Hunter Weapon plus a material selector (silver/cold_iron/consecrated/wood/cursed → the bane key) and an origin; on create the weapon is materialised as a character-owned Item and marked via setHunterWeapon. (2) SPECIALTY die-bump automation — the two Specialties live on the Innate guise; a player arms armSpecialtyDieBump(actor) for their next check and FU's prepareCheck hook improves ONE attribute die a size, EXCLUDING Magic and Accuracy checks (Austin's ruling), restored in processCheck. D-Bonus stays provisional/data-only (held pending Austin). Tests 43/43. ⚠ the die-bump raises actor.system.attributes[attr].current transiently in prepareCheck (FU builds the roll die from .current at roll time) — verify live on FU 4.16.2 that the bump survives to the roll and restores. --- v0.7.0 GUISE-BUILDER-FIX (ROS-24): the Builder was under-constrained (every affinity could be Absorption) and missing core fields. Guardrails now enforced: EXACTLY 3 distinct classes (Q4); the affinity TRIO — one Immunity + one Vulnerability + one Resistance, an Immunity MUST be paired with a Vulnerability, and ABSORPTION IS NEVER OFFERED (Q6/Q7); the un-canon 'Governing skill' + 'Max forms collectable' monstrous controls are REMOVED (Q7). Missing fields wired: Guise Equipment (was hardcoded []), Perk (curated list), a +3 Bonus with a check-type selector (Q3 — PROVISIONAL taxonomy: Accuracy/Magic/Open/Opposed/Group; Austin to confirm/adjust live), a narrative Bane (Q2), a Tell, a narrative flaw, and a plain-text Nature (Q5). NEW Innate-Guise mode (Q1): two Specialties + one creation Heroic (creation-banned heroics refused), no armour/hands/affinities/perk/tell — a worn guise never carries a Heroic. 6-step wizard (Identity/Classes/Skills/Loadout/Affinities/Review). Headless tests 37/37. Registers a first-class 'guise' classFeature (Arcanum pattern) via CONFIG.FU.classFeatureRegistry. No FU content redistributed.
